relationships.subject: sFlt-1
relationships.evidence_quote: In the normotensive group, there was a positive correlation between sFlt-1 and postpartum PSS (ρ +0.214 and P = 0.043)

relationships.subject: sFlt-1
relationships.evidence_quote: In sPE group on postpartum day 3, there was a statistically significant negative correlation between pre-delivery sFlt-1 and VNRS (rho −0.465 and p = 0.003).

key_findings: In normotensive women, pre-delivery sFlt-1 and sFlt-1/PIGF ratio positively correlated with postpartum perceived stress.
In severe pre-eclampsia, pre-delivery sFlt-1 negatively correlated with postpartum pain scores on days 2-3.
